nodes.title: Matrix mortality
nodes.summary: Whether some nonempty product of finitely many integer matrices is zero, with the dimension d and the number k of matrices fixed.

nodes.title: Word-pair matrices
nodes.summary: Three-dimensional integer matrices that multiply like pairs of words and detect equality of the two words in one entry.

nodes.title: Fixed-boundary correspondence
nodes.summary: Four of Neary’s word pairs with one fixed boundary word recognize halting of binary tag systems, for every word over the pairs.

nodes.title: Paired scalar series
nodes.summary: Three integer 4 × 4 matrices whose coefficient vanishes on a word exactly when the decoded tiles solve fixed-boundary correspondence; four dimensions are exact.

nodes.title: Paired-role compression
nodes.summary: Four maps that agree in pairs on an r-dimensional subspace become two data maps and a toggle in dimension 2d − r, with the same coefficients.

nodes.title: Rank-one separator
nodes.summary: A rank-one generator built from the boundary row and column turns a vanishing coefficient into a zero product; the converse covers every product.

nodes.title: Interface compression
nodes.summary: Mortality of transitions and factored cuts equals mortality of the transitions or of a path of small interface bridges.

nodes.title: Singular-return compression
nodes.summary: For a transition A with no vanishing power and a cut UO, the pair is mortal exactly when its returns O Aⁿ U are.

nodes.title: Finitely many return shapes
nodes.summary: If every return is a nonzero multiple of one of finitely many matrices, each occurring, the returns and those matrices are mortal together.

nodes.title: Six-dimensional scalar compiler
nodes.summary: Two-bit codewords spell the four tiles; sharing coordinates after the phase bit gives two 6 × 6 matrices with the same coefficients.

nodes.title: Generator packing
nodes.summary: Spelling generators in a prefix code trades generators for dimension: M_d(hk + 1) reduces to M_kd(h + 1).

nodes.title: Binary prefix decoder
nodes.summary: A complete binary prefix code spells the five matrices of M₃(5) on four blocks of dimension three; a synchronizing word handles every start.

nodes.title: Common-image restriction
nodes.summary: Both twelve-dimensional generators map into a ten-dimensional subspace; one appended letter turns every restricted zero into an original zero.

nodes.title: Tilted separator
nodes.summary: A separator row (1, q, q, q) whose zeros are exactly those of the paired series, by injectivity of the tilted code σ(x) + q·3^|x|.

nodes.title: Nine-dimensional return realization
nodes.summary: A transition with Jordan blocks of sizes 3, 3, 2 and one eigenline whose returns are the three controls and multiples of the tilted separator.

nodes.title: Floor for uniform rows
nodes.summary: At a benchmark source, every exact realization of the uniform-row return sequences needs nine dimensions, for every tail and slope.

nodes.title: Denominator clearing
nodes.summary: Scaling each generator by its own nonzero integer preserves and reflects every zero product, and unreduced fractions keep the scaling primitive recursive.

nodes.title: Valuation guard
nodes.summary: Two 3 × 3 matrices whose returns act by Möbius maps, admit one wait per step by a p-adic valuation, and are mortal exactly when a deterministic orbit reaches 1.

nodes.title: Immortality certificates
nodes.summary: Parity of the reset-defect numerator and valuation walls at primes dividing p − 1 prove large parameter regions of the guard immortal.

nodes.title: Two-generator projective incidence
nodes.summary: Whether some product of two invertible rational 2 × 2 matrices moves a given column into the kernel of a given row.

nodes.title: Shortcut-Collatz reachability
nodes.summary: Whether a given integer reaches 1 under x ↦ x/2 for even x and x ↦ (3x + 1)/2 for odd x.

nodes.title: Shortcut-Collatz incidence
nodes.summary: For each nonzero integer n, two fixed Möbius maps and a target depending on n have an incidence exactly when n reaches 1.

nodes.title: Rank-two incidence compiler
nodes.summary: Every generic incidence instance becomes two rational 3 × 3 matrices of rank two, mortal exactly when the instance has a solution.

nodes.title: M₃(5) is undecidable
nodes.summary: Four tile matrices and one rank-one separator. On the current frontier.

nodes.title: M₄(4) is undecidable
nodes.summary: The paired series and one rank-one separator, with a converse for singular controls. On the current frontier.

nodes.title: Z₆(2) is undecidable
nodes.summary: The six-dimensional scalar compiler, with common first column e₁. On the current scalar frontier.

nodes.title: R₇(2) is undecidable
nodes.summary: The scalar-to-corner reduction applied to Z₆(2). On the current corner frontier.

nodes.title: M₁₀(2) is undecidable
nodes.summary: The binary prefix decoder restricted to its common image. Subsumed by M₉(2).

nodes.title: M₉(2) is undecidable
nodes.summary: The tilted separator and a nine-dimensional return realization. Subsumed by M₈(2).

nodes.title: M₆(3) is undecidable
nodes.summary: Generator packing applied to M₃(5). On the current frontier.

nodes.title: M₁₂(2) is undecidable
nodes.summary: Generator packing applied to M₃(5). Subsumed by M₁₀(2).

nodes.title: Wrong-phase exclusion
nodes.summary: The rule-phase value of the asymmetric row never vanishes: a zero would force a forbidden period of the body’s code.

nodes.title: Asymmetric separator
nodes.summary: The row (1, a, q, q) fixed by two linear conditions accepts only deletion-phase zeros; a leading toggle recovers every other witness.

nodes.title: Eight-dimensional return realization
nodes.summary: Two nilpotent chains of length three, one static coordinate, and one eigenline realize a scaled toggle, both data controls, and the asymmetric separator.

nodes.title: M₈(2) is undecidable
nodes.summary: The asymmetric separator and an eight-dimensional return realization. On the current frontier; M₇(2) is open.

views.title: Problems
views.summary: The decision problems the constructions start from and end at.

views.title: Halting as a Word Equation
views.summary: The undecidable source: tag-system halting as equality of two concatenations with a fixed boundary.

views.title: A Word Equation as One Coefficient
views.summary: Matrix representations whose single coefficient vanishes exactly on solutions, with fewer generators or coordinates than the naive encoding.

views.title: One Coefficient as a Zero Product
views.summary: Separators and cuts that make a whole product vanish exactly when a coefficient does, including separator rows chosen to reduce dimension.

views.title: Two Generators, Low Dimension, Integer Entries
views.summary: Realizations that present many shapes with two matrices, their limits, and the passage from rational to integer entries.

views.title: Undecidability Theorems
views.summary: Each card states whether the cell is on the current frontier or implied by a sharper theorem.

views.title: The Cell M₃(2)
views.summary: Exact equivalences between families of 3 × 3 pairs and arithmetic orbit questions; they do not settle the cell.
